newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Meister sees no current risk in dollar/mark.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Meister sees no current risk in dollar/mark.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Edgar Meister said on Monday that he saw no risks for Germany with the current dollar/mark exchange rate.
"I see no risk at the moment (with the dollar), as long as it does not become a trend," Meister told reporters during a press conference at the Bundesbank.
The mark, which has depreciated sharply against the dollar in recent months, was trading at 1.7443 to the dollar by 1002 GMT.
